taskPurpose.exactNormativeText: Wallet alpha profiles use point-in-time realized/executable outcomes, entry timing, liquidity, risk exposure, sample confidence, and regime/narrative specialization.
Wallet entity resolution distinguishes owners, token accounts, routers, exchanges, funders, copy traders, creators, infrastructure, and uncertain links with versioned confidence.
Wallet-cohort independence discounts shared funders, synchronized acquisition, shared creator links, identical route behavior, common off-chain signal timing, and correlated exits.
Insider or creator proximity is represented separately from predictive success; insider-associated profitability cannot be promoted as organic smart-wallet evidence.
Reputation uses hierarchical shrinkage, minimum matured samples, survivorship adjustment, and staleness/decay; low-confidence profiles cannot independently promote a candidate.
Wallet lineage outputs expose evidence, unresolved identity risk, copy-trader probability, net exposure change, realized behavior, and historical failure/rug exposure.
Evaluation of wallet alpha for a token excludes that token’s own future outcome and uses asset/entity/lineage-aware cross-fitting where reputation is a learned downstream feature.
